FULL TEXT:
OFFICE OF THE DISTRICT PROGRAMME OFFICER, ICDS (Cell),
EAST KHASI HILLS & RI-BHOI DISTRICT
GOVERNMENT OF MEGHALAYA
For the implementation of the POSHAN (PM's Overarching Scheme for Holistic Nourishment)
Abhiyaan- National Nutrition Mission, Applications are invited from eligible and interested
candidates who are domicile of Umling C & RD Block for the following post, on contract basis.
Period of Posting:
1 (One) Post of Block Coordinator in the Office of the Child Development Project
Officer, Umling ICDS Project.
ADVERTISEMENT
Essential Qualification and Experience:
Upto 31.03.2027.
Graduate in any discipline with at least 2 years' experience of working with
technology and software application support
Good oral and written communication in local language.
Mandatorily local candidates should be engaged
Desirable:
Consolidated Remuneration:
Rs. 20,000/- per month
Formal training on IT/computer
Scope of Work:
Worked with frontline workers in any Social Development Program of
Government
Proven ability to successfully handle multiple tasks with a team environment.
Attention to detail and problem solving skills
1. Supporting training of AWWs and Supervisors in Information and Communication
Technology enabled Real Time Monitoring(1CT-RTM)
2. Monitoring usage of ICT-RTM by AWWs by using POSHAN Tracker and follow-up on
low usage.
3. Providing in-person and over-phone troubleshooting support to users facing hardware or
software problems with mobiles, tablets and basic issues with POSHAN Tracker
application.
4. Logging issues in the Issue Tracker application.
5. Training reinforcement to AWWs identified as low performers using POSHAN Tracker.
6. Providing performance feedback to A WWs
7. Submiting phones to Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for Hardware
replacement and repair
8. Escalation of issues to Block/District Coordinator via the issue Tracker application.
9. Supporting Block Level ICDS officials on usage of POSHAN Tracker.
10. Any other task as indicated by the Child Development Project Officer.
Last date for receipt of Applications – 30" October, 2026
Candidates without the desirable qualifications/experience need not apply.
Applications in Standard Form, duly fille, along with 2 (two) attested passport size
photographs,attested copies of certificates and self addressed envelope size 4.5 x 11 cms, may
be submitted to:
The Office of the Child Development Project Officer, Umling ICDS Project,
Saiden Mawdaron, Nongpoh -793102, Ri Bhoi District.
Memo No DPO(S)NM/RB/26/2018-19/1180-84
